Jordan — thanks for the clear asks. Summary + proposed 4-week trial plan below (attachment: RL-Playground-POC-criteria.xlsx, mutual_action_plan_playground.docx). I kept this intentionally concise for CTO/procurement review.

Executive summary (one line): Run a 4-week trial focused on conversational retrieval for internal knowledge base search; target is parity with current Retrieval+Rerank baseline at <= 30% lower latency and demonstrable cost-per-query reduction.

Goals & success criteria:
- Functional: F1/precision on named-entity QA >= 0.88 versus baseline testset (we'll deliver a 300-item evaluation set).
- Latency: 95th-percentile tail <= 500ms for 8k token context under expected concurrency profile.
- Cost: Token cost per successful query <= 30% of your current endpoint spend (we'll provide modeled estimates based on sample QPS).
- Reliability: <1% error rate over 7-day rolling window; traceability to model versions and request ids for all requests.

Proposed trial scope & timeline:
- Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): Access provisioning (API keys, VPC peering / Private deployment checklist), baseline ingestion of 150k docs.
- Week 1 (integration): Ingest production sample, integrate retrieval pipeline, validate responses on 50 eval prompts.
- Week 2 (load & quality): Run 72-hour soak test at target concurrency; collect latency/cost metrics and reweight retrieval.
- Week 3 (optimizations): Apply batching/quantization profiles recommended by Redwood Optimize; run A/B on quality-sensitive routes.
- Week 4 (final validation): Run full eval, prepare executive summary and handoff.

Ownership (suggested):
- Redwood AE: Ben Carter — commercial touchpoint, contract/credits/uptime SLA questions.
- Redwood Solutions: Olga Petrov — integration plan, evaluation sets, runbook.
- Redwood CS: Marissa Cole — success criteria validation and onboarding support.
- Playground Labs: Jordan Peel (engineer lead), + Procurement and CTO observers.

Immediate next actions (for this week):
1) Playground: confirm dataset owner and an eng contact for VPC details (Jordan — can you confirm?).
2) Redwood: send the POC criteria workbook and mutual action plan (attached).
3) Procurement: flag any mandatory contract terms we should include up front so we don't delay the start.

Attachments: RL-Playground-POC-criteria.xlsx (POC metrics, eval set format); mutual_action_plan_playground.docx (mutual action plan + timeline).

I can schedule a 30-minute kickoff once you confirm access owners — available Wed/Thu afternoon PST.
